nodes.label: Backend (bot) service :3000
nodes.rationale: Handles orders, users, products, settings. Bot slowness decoupled from slow Billz sync; marketplace traffic does not share Billz rate limit.

nodes.label: channel-hub service :3100
nodes.rationale: Billz key stays in one process; backend never reads it. Owns billz products mirror, channel orders, channel keys.

nodes.label: Medicalka channel adapter
nodes.rationale: Token in query string (?token= read, ?secret= orders); out-of-stock returns 404 per contract.

nodes.label: Uzum Tezkor channel adapter
nodes.rationale: Yandex Eats family; eatsId is idempotency key; 15-min auto-cancel of unconfirmed orders.

nodes.label: Billz external API
nodes.rationale: 2 req/s with heuristic burst blocking; single queue in channel-hub.

nodes.label: Ostatok model: stock / reservedQty / pendingQty
nodes.rationale: Billz is sole source of stock, but customer never sees number only bor/yoq. reservedQty/pendingQty never rewritten by sync because double-counting drifts mirror permanently; reservationApplied/pendingApplied flags prevent double-hold and double-release on retry.

nodes.label: reservedQty subtraction is mandatory
nodes.rationale: Measured in live company: API reserved 3 units but active_measurement_value stayed 1080 for 10s. Billz records otложка but does not subtract from stock. Reading Billz stock raw oversells across all marketplaces.

nodes.label: Visibility rules priority cascade
nodes.rationale: 1) no image->hidden always 2) admin unapproved->hidden 3) admin manual bor/yoq OVER Billz 4) unlinked->untouched 5) gone from Billz->hidden not deleted 6) else Billz stock. Image rule intentionally above manual decision: sellable is operator choice, a working card is a requirement.

nodes.label: Order lifecycle: received->reserved->sold/cancelled/failed
nodes.rationale: Single record type channelorders for all channels. Medicalka/Uzum reserve on order arrival; bot reserves only after Telegram confirmation.

nodes.label: Repeat-order protection via unique (channel, externalId)
nodes.rationale: A repeat order never becomes a second sale. Unique index decides concurrent duplicates; loser reads the winner back instead of erroring.

nodes.label: Response given before Billz
nodes.rationale: Uzum cancels unconfirmed order in 15 min. Acceptance cannot depend on external system speed.

nodes.label: Goal propagation, not events
nodes.rationale: Duplicated event = two sales; duplicated goal = one. Skipped step still reserves. No missed call points because there are no call points scanner compares orders to goals. orders.billzSync.dispatched is last confirmed goal; nextAttemptAt doubles as backoff and lease.

nodes.label: Local hold pendingQty mechanism with BOT_HOLD_TTL_MS
nodes.rationale: Minutes/hours pass between order and confirmation; units stay sellable on marketplaces meanwhile. pendingQty holds them locally; TTL 2h then releases protection keeps order open without freezing goods forever from a forgotten order.
nodes.norm_label: local hold pendingqty mechanism with bot_hold_ttl_ms

nodes.label: BILLZ_BRIDGE_SINCE hard boundary
nodes.rationale: Orders before this timestamp are never considered; without it enabling bridge would re-reserve entire order history into Billz.

nodes.label: Enforced collection boundary: defineModel / defineReadModel
nodes.rationale: Boundary is enforced not negotiated. defineModel refuses non-writable collections = startup crash not silent data loss. defineReadModel returns frozen facade with no update/delete/save.

nodes.label: Stateless Uzum OAuth token validation
nodes.rationale: Token is signed claim (channel, key id, expiry); verify via signature + key single-index read per request. Revocation is immediate. Token pool would leak every uncleared token till expiry. Signing key mandatory no default or any deployment-issued token works here.

nodes.label: Image policy: Billz CDN forbidden, SHA-1 cached, drop if unhashable
nodes.rationale: Billz forbids serving its CDN media; Uzum requires hash per image. Both resolved by operator-uploaded images on our disk with one-time SHA-1. If hash cannot be computed image is dropped not invented bytes not depicting the image cache worse than no hash.
nodes.norm_label: image policy: billz cdn forbidden, sha-1 cached, drop if unhashable

nodes.label: Channel-hub edits one Telegram message per order
nodes.rationale: Marketplace orders bypass bot; channel-hub sends card and edits it on status change. For bot orders backend sends the card; channel-hub only speaks on Billz error the one thing backend card cannot show. No webhook/callback in this service prevents anyone with channel-write rights from moving stock.
nodes.norm_label: channel-hub edits one telegram message per order

nodes.label: Single payment type for all channel sales
nodes.rationale: All sales to Баланс поставщика 42bb647e... Billz report groups all channels into one number; differentiation is in sale comment carrying channel name + external order id so single sale always traceable to order. Channel revenue split is our panel not Billz report.
nodes.norm_label: single payment type for all channel sales

nodes.label: POST /v2/order/return-postpone (release reserve)
nodes.rationale: cancel_postpone endpoint does NOT exist - costly guess gave 404 and 403 misleadingly. Correct method confirmed from official list then exercised live. Release returns to draft does NOT delete; second delete step added so cancelled order leaves no empty draft forever.

nodes.label: POST /v2/order-payment/:id (sale, deliberately untested)
nodes.rationale: Sale method reduces real stock and writes a receipt; tested in test company not prod. Full chain draft->line->reserve->release->delete exercised 3x live returned to original stock.

nodes.label: Line delete contradicts docs (math_value=0 vs min 0.01)
nodes.rationale: Docs say measurement_value:0 but API validator rejects with min_allowed:0.01. Full draft delete works so this method is not needed.
nodes.norm_label: line delete contradicts docs (math_value=0 vs min 0.01)

nodes.label: Test strategy: real MongoDB + real HTTP
nodes.rationale: Idempotency and counters forced by unique index and $inc so require real MongoDB; mock proves neither. Contract shapes via real HTTP because content-type and error envelope invisible in handler unit test. backend 122 tests channel-hub 145.
nodes.norm_label: test strategy: real mongodb + real http

nodes.label: channelorders collection (single type for all channels)
nodes.norm_label: channelorders collection (single type for all channels)

nodes.label: Security surfaces summary
nodes.rationale: Medicalka key SHA-256 lookup separate read/order keys; Uzum OAuth2 bearer signature+key reread revocation immediate; /internal loopback+static token never nginx-proxied; admin panel signed Telegram initData only; Billz key only in channel-hub process; keys only SHA-256 stored plaintext shown once; write flags all shipped off. Price always from our catalog not request body or marketplace decides its payment.

nodes.label: sync-once.js script
nodes.rationale: --dry-run first; --force only on first fill so shrink guard does not treat empty mirror as catalog shrinkage. Sync rejected if Billz returns <50% of mirror (2x) to prevent partial response hiding all channel stock.

nodes.label: link-billz.js script
nodes.rationale: Splits matches CONFIDENT written / AMBIGUOUS not written (two equal matches usually same product different packaging) / NO MATCH normal (test strips breastfeeding accessories not in Billz).

nodes.label: reconcile-stock.js script
nodes.rationale: Changes store visibility. Report first: no_image hides even if manual bor; gone_from_billz wrong link; not_linked and manual_override untouched. Rollback via STOCK_RECONCILE_ENABLED=false changed isAvailable values persisting restores from mongodump.

nodes.label: issue-key.js script
nodes.rationale: Revoke immediate (Uzum bearer too because checked per-request against key). Terminal alt to admin panel key button plaintext shown once lost=reissue not recover.

nodes.label: Security flags all-shipped-off
nodes.rationale: BILLZ_WRITE_ENABLED / BILLZ_BRIDGE_ENABLED / UZUM_ENABLED / STOCK_RECONCILE_ENABLED / TELEGRAM_USE_WEBHOOK / SEED_ON_EMPTY / ALLOW_IN_MEMORY_DB all off by default; turn on individually after checks. Uzum half-config fails to start on purpose avoiding runtime misleading errors. SEED_ON_EMPTY never in prod; ALLOW_IN_MEMORY_DB auto-rejected when NODE_ENV=production.

nodes.label: nginx: /internal never proxied (404)
nodes.rationale: /internal moves stock. Service binds 127.0.0.1 by default; if HOST changed requires CHANNEL_INTERNAL_TOKEN 32+ chars and refuses to start otherwise.

nodes.label: MongoDB backup procedure
nodes.rationale: channel-hub collections (billzproducts synclogs billztokens) re-sync. channelkeys NOT restorable keys reissued. products orders users = primary data backups for these.

nodes.label: billzProductId_unique index (drop old billzProductId_1)
nodes.rationale: Unique index blocks one Billz product binding to two cards; leftover non-unique billzProductId_1 harmless but extra write load.

nodes.label: Troubleshooting playbook
nodes.rationale: billzSync.lastError transient auto-retry; conflict needs human (delivered-cancel attempt = return different account). 429 Billz rate limit client backs off lower BILLZ_RPS. Uzum 401 token expiry auto-refresh or revoked key reissue.
